title: eludite.editor.go_to_definition input
description: Go To Definition (F12, Ctrl+click): ask the language server where the symbol at `line`, `column` (or the caret) is defined. The current position is pushed on the navigation history first. One target opens its file at the definition; a symbol defined in a referenced assembly opens a read-only tab titled like Visual Studio's (`JsonRpc [from metadata]`) with the language server's metadata-as-source text; several targets (partial types, for example) show a picker. A new call cancels the previous request; a result for an older document version or solution generation is dropped.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line of the symbol; the caret when omitted.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) of the symbol; 1 when omitted.

target.description: Choose target `target` (0-based, in the order of the output's `targets`) of the picker the previous call opened, instead of asking the language server again.
